_about: Each character's voice for Voice Studio's 'Describe a voice' (VoxCPM2): who, how it sounds, how it speaks. pitch: the median pitch range (Hz) a candidate should fall in; rate: words per second it should roughly speak at. tools/voices.py design reads this. These were the FIRST designs: after the voice test (2026-11-08) Mitch's stands, and Marge, Gus, Coach Bev, Vernon and Sal get their voices from tools/voice-styles.json (round 2) via `voices.py use`. respell: what the voice model is given instead of the script's words, for every recorded line.

mitch.name: Mitch
mitch.describe: A man in his early thirties, an eager, overconfident diner assistant manager. Medium-high, slightly nasal voice, a little strained. Fast, chatty and upbeat, with a smug, sarcastic edge, like he has had four coffees. Clear studio recording.
mitch.sample: Doors are open. Try not to set anything on fire. I'll be supervising.

marge.name: Marge
marge.describe: An elderly woman around seventy, a retired school-bus driver. A warm, slightly raspy older voice. Unhurried, sweet but dry and knowing, a grandmother who has seen everything twice. Clear studio recording.
marge.sample: Hi, hon. The usual. You know how I like it.
marge._respell: Voice test round 1: 'hon' after a comma sounded unnatural and was heard as 'Aunt'; 'hun' with no comma is what the model gets (captions keep 'hon').

gus.name: Gus
gus.describe: A big, burly man around fifty, a long-haul trucker. A very low, deep, rumbling voice. Slow, relaxed and friendly, a kind gentle giant. Clear studio recording.
gus.sample: Howdy, buddy. Eleven hours of highway, and I am hungry.

bev.name: Coach Bev
bev.describe: A woman in her forties, a high-school gym coach. A loud, booming, energetic voice with a bit of rasp. Shouting like she is on the sidelines, intense and enthusiastic. Clear studio recording.
bev.sample: Let's go! I'm starving! Hustle, hustle, I've got practice in twenty!
bev._calm: Voice test (2026-11-08): with '!' and ALL CAPS the model shouted every clone of Bev's line up to 220-360 Hz, 'too high pitch, distorted'; it gets full stops and lower case, and her low voice carries the coach.

vernon.name: Vernon
vernon.describe: A man around forty, a pompous burger-review blogger. A deep, slow, droning, nasal monotone. Deeply bored and unimpressed, pretentious, sighing between words. Clear studio recording.
vernon.sample: Good evening. I will be reviewing tonight. My eleven followers are waiting.
